home.comment: Joints centered; GRIP at 1950 (its own center, since its range is 1500..2500 not 500..2500).

open_grip.comment: Jaws open. GRIP is uncalibrated, so poses must stay inside its *provisional* band (center 1950 +/- 300 = 1650..2250), not just the wider configured 1600..2300 -- 1650 is the closest safe value to the 1500 open stop reachable without an explicit calibration override.

close_grip.comment: Jaws partially closed. Never use an absolute close on empty air -- use the grip ladder. 2300 stays 200 clear of 2500.
